trust_decision.summary: Whether a value used as a document _id or relation key may carry a MongoDB operator document; at the pinned commit only the 3-arg where('=') on id-like columns rejects it, while compileWheres passes 2-arg/shorthand _id values and model/relation key values through convertKey unchecked.

landing_point.why: The id-like operator rejection already lives in where(); an engineer reading 'operator injected as id/relation key' starts there. (The advisory summary text instead names cache lock owners, src/Cache/MongoLock.php:52, which is already fixed at the pinned commit - see unverified.)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Embedded relations are a separate feature keyed on 'localKey._id', and the fix itself deliberately exempts '._id' columns from the check (castKey), so a solver can argue embedded ids are out of scope and leave convertKey unchecked.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: BelongsToMany::detach passes the unchecked parent key to Builder::pull(), where a non-list array becomes a $pull condition document
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is an update ($pull) not a lookup, and pull() accepts condition documents by design (src/Query/Builder.php:1119-1133), so it looks like a different feature from 'query by id'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as fixed BelongsToMany::setWhere (line 91), different method; sink in src/Query/Builder.php:1119

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MorphToMany::detach (inverse) passes the unchecked parent key to Builder::pull() as a $pull condition
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Write path on the inverse (morphedByMany) side; the fix only touched read constraints in the same file.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix sites MorphToMany.php:70-98

O8_uncovered_routes.route: BelongsToMany::attach / MorphToMany::attach push the unchecked parent key into related documents
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Stored as data via $push/$addToSet, not interpreted as a query operator at write time.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a job/batch id lookup that uses a raw collection call instead of where('_id', $id), bypassing compileWheres
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Queue and Bus code already mixes the query builder with raw collection calls (src/Bus/MongoBatchRepository.php:50), so a direct findOneAndUpdate(['_id' => $id]) is a plausible maintainer choice.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an embedded-id route that builds its key without getForeignKeyValue()/convertKey and relies on the '._id' castKey path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix makes '._id' columns skip the check on purpose; a second embedded helper building the key directly would look natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the excludeId/idColumn route using '=' or 2-arg where on a custom id column
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The unique-rule 'ignore' id comes from request input and the verifier already overrides the Laravel base.

O9_family: NoSQL operator injection (CWE-943) into _id / relation-key values
